all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 840 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 53 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 36.1°S, 165.4°E, about 840 km from Auckland.
This far north, they're roughly level with Seoul, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 3,491 m below the ship, which is about 10.6 Eiffel Towers stacked up.
